name: Polynomial dimension p<=n^A
statement: p=p_n<=n^A for a fixed A>=1 (p>>n allowed); source says it comes from prior + proof technique, e^{Cn^alpha} OPEN
notes: Used by every headline except identity (N1) and exact-Gram CS/PK (p<=n-1). Variants: A:P-ALPHA0, A:P-HALF, A:P-HALF-N.

name: Beta-min
statement: BM-inf: theta*_min^2 n phi0^2/(sigma^2 log n)->inf (or BM(c), c>c0=max{4C*,32[s0(A+1)+2]}); random-Gaussian classes: fixed theta_lo>0
notes: Two roles: posterior concentration (T03#) and TL(L) event (BM-inf only). GEN uses BM-inf only (BM(c) not used). Bridge to TL: C-GROW:L2.1 / W2-FAC-A:L3.2.

name: Bounded signal energy
statement: ||mu||^2<=Mn, mu=X theta*, fixed M (random Gaussian rows: theta* bounded, s0 fixed)
notes: Part of T03# hypothesis R; also hypothesis of toolkit lemmas (W1-GEN:L1, W2-LOC2:L0').

name: Anchored sparse eigenvalue floors
statement: lambda_min(R_{S0 u J})>=phi0^2 for |J|<=j0=ceil((2A+1)s0)+1 (SE_lambda) and unnormalised >=g0 for |J|<=m#_n (SE_w); lambda_min(R_S0)>=phi0^2
notes: Random-design form is A:LSF (bridge W2-APP:POST). m#_n=O(log n), so supports of size O(log n).

name: Fixed sparsity
statement: s0=|S0|>=1 fixed (independent of n); s0<=K eventually
notes: GROW/LOC allow |Q|=O(log n) relevance set but s0 still fixed.

name: Gaussian noise
statement: eps ~ N(0,sigma^2 I_n) independent of the design, sigma^2>0 fixed (beta may be X-measurable)
notes: Consumed via chi^2/Gaussian-tail toolkit (union bounds over polynomial families); bridge = uniform score expansion lemma.

name: T03# hypothesis bundle (H0)
statement: fixed design: R (energy, lambda_min(R_S0)), SE_lambda, SE_w, BM, p<=n^A, fixed s0; Gaussian noise
implies: A:P-POLY; A:BETAMIN; A:ENERGY; A:SPARSE-EIG; A:FIXED-S0; A:GAUSS-NOISE
notes: Named (H0) in GEN/GROW/FAC-A, (H-MIS) in MIS, 'automatic' in FAC-B (A=1, phi0^2=1-rho). Bundle id for convenience; the components are the shared assumptions.

name: Logarithmic sparse floor (random Gaussian rows)
statement: lambda_min(Sigma_{n,S})>=phi^2 for |S|<=s0+j0 and >=psi_n (psi_n sqrt(n)/(log n)^{3/2}->inf) for |S|<=kbar_n=O(log n); implied by global floor lambda_min>=c
notes: Random-design replacement of A:SPARSE-EIG/A:ENERGY/A:BETAMIN: T03# hyps on X-events of prob->1 with common constants+envelope. Used by APP POST, LOC, PLR(C-ii), LOC2 Poly, F-UNI.

name: Iid Gaussian rows
statement: raw rows iid N(m_n,Sigma_n), Sigma_n unit-diagonal WLOG, eps independent of rows; used with common-constant design events
notes: No single bridge (iid rows => sample-Gram/design events with common constants). Per family: W1-PXN:CR, C-GROW:L6.2, W2-APP:POST, W2-FAC-A:L5, W2-FAC-X:X2, W2-LOC2:NA-R. De-randomisation step itself: P:DERANDOMISE (W1-GEN:Thm-GEN(C4), C-MIS:LemDR).

name: Exact Gram
statement: X'X=(n-1)Sigma_n exactly (so p<=n-1); sample Gram = population Gram
notes: Family-free statement; instances A:INST-CS/A:INST-FACTOR. Implies A:GRAM-OP-BOUND with delta_n=0.

name: Approximate Gram in operator norm
statement: ||R_hat-Sigma_n||_op<=delta_n with delta_n sqrt(p log log n)->0 (delta_n=0: exact Gram)
notes: Coupling step of FAC-A L1/(L5); (E) in W2-UNI. Among headlines: FAC-A (and F-UNI via UNI).

name: Gram floor on the relevance lattice
statement: lambda_min(R_{Q u {l}})>=phi0^2 for every l in [p] (G2); (H1a) in GEN
notes: Needed so (I-P_T)x_l!=0 on the lattice; GEN (H1a), GROW (G2). Random form: A:LSF.

name: Bounded/log/polylog relevance set Q
statement: deterministic Q>=S0 with |Q|<=vbar (GEN) / C_Q log n (GROW,LOC) / (log n)^k (PLR) and Q=[p] or K>=2|Q|+32s0+1; lattice L={S0<=T<=Q}
notes: Binding: union bound over 2^|Q| lattice sets (NA) and size ladder. Obstructions: W2-APP:VN-routes, W2-APP:Ex-STAR, W1-GEN:Cex-GEN(C6). Bridge per scale: W1-GEN:L3 (bounded), C-GROW:L2.3 (log), W2-LOC2:NA-R (polylog).

name: Blocks of size <=16
statement: method partition is an X-measurable partition into blocks of size <=B=min(floor(sqrt n),floor(sqrt p),16)<=16
notes: No lemma states blocks<=16 => property used. It enters inside C-GROW:L3 (visibility over 2^16 subsets) and W1-N3 (exact block tables). Binding: enumeration of U<=C_b (2^16) in visibility conditions and block tables. 'Any partition' in FAC-A/B/UNI; coded partition in GEN/GROW.

name: SIZE: block size matches group size
statement: g<=B_n<2g so complete-linkage+next-fit blocks = groups w.p.->1 (LH-iid); PK variant (PB): all but J0 blocks of size exactly 16
notes: Bridge to P:PARTITION-RECOVERY is PXN Thm-R. Study design (groups of 5) violates SIZE. PK (PB) is a hypothesis, not proved for the coded partition.

name: Block-level visibility of truths (no masking)
statement: truths visible inside blocks given any U<=C_b: delta^2_{U,j}>=M_n log n (TV) or population partial covariance >=a0 / !=0 for |U|<=15 (PTV, FS)
notes: Property used: sandwich S0<=S~0<=Q (P:SAND). GEN VIS(S*) allows masked truths (S* certificate). Instances A:FS, A:PTV, TV-pop. Bridges: C-GROW:L3, W2-FAC-A:L2, W2-APP:Thm-LOC, W2-FAC-B:L2, W2-FAC-X:X5.

name: Generic no-cancellation (FS) on CS designs
statement: theta(V)!=0 for V<=S0 and theta_l+rho theta(V)/(1+(u-1)rho)!=0 for u<=15, i.e. population Cov(x_l,mu|x_U)!=0 for |U|<=15 except U>=S0,l null
notes: Instance of A:BLOCK-VIS for compound symmetry (restated as the property: partial covariance nonzero). FAC-B C1-M weakens to (FS'); GC-CS in FAC-A (I)(a) is the same type.

name: LS0 implementation premises (OP)
statement: EX-A, EX-S, SR, GUARD-W, OP-LS0 (LS0 executed, centre emitted, scans completed on every fit in O), e4/e4' (emitted centre = a start-mode maximiser), complete scans; IND-T if R'>4
notes: Named premises, not discharged ([OP] closure unchecked). FAC-A/B, GROW restate with e4'; FAC-A notes its delivery premise list is stronger than the 'some maximiser' needed for (L4).

name: Calibration idealisation CAL
statement: calibration value is a function of data and pre-streams; used in M5(0) assembly of reported consistency; NOT assumed in delivery claims
notes: Delivery results (Cor-Dp, F-FAC, FAC-CS (C4)) replace CAL by a pathwise argument. FAC-CS (C3) uses CAL; FAC-CS (C4) is CAL-free.

name: LS0 move cap MR1 (a_n=l_n+|S~0|)
statement: LS0 move cap ell^{LS0}=ell_n+|S~0| (merged main 4676af6); legacy cap ell_n suffices only under (G4-chi)
notes: Property: cap>=|C minus S0|-1 so the capped path scores S0. Failure: legacy cap misses S0 when m0>=ell_n+2 (FAC-B/FAC-X (C2)); merged cap fails on K

name: Delivery premises and allocation (Prop F)
statement: total tier-1 fallback freezing; EX-A unit-cost, IDEAL-W, EX-S, SR, e4+TDP-IMPL, GUARD-W, MACH, CONFIG (R'=4k), valid seed, A1 allocation+A4 preflight, cap a_n; P1/S.3 AUDITED (code reading)
notes: Fallback is a change to a shipped component (implemented later as C-ENG:Impl-DLV-B). Bridge to P:NO-OUTPUT-ZERO.

name: Metric locality with spectrum in [c,C]
statement: Sigma_n (or its inverse) has spectrum in [c,C] and |entries|<=K e^{-a d(j,k)} for a pseudometric of polynomial growth (line, R^d, graph)
notes: Property used: uniform exponential decay of conditional covariances/spectra (P:COND-COV-DECAY). Variants W2-LOC2:CD_d, W2-UNI:CD_M.

name: Population signal visibility PTV(a0)
statement: for j in S0, U<=[p]-{j}, |U|<=15: |Cov(W_j,sum theta_k W_k | W_U)|>=a0>0
notes: Random-design instance of block visibility; APP LOC, LOC2 (PLR, Poly), UNI (A3); not used by UNI-P.

name: Reference frames/atoms for no-addition (R1)-(R3)
statement: population residual e_{T,l}=r_{T,l}-sum lambda a W with <=m0 fixed-dim frame vectors, l1-bounded atoms L_n^2 log|A_n|=o(log n), Var(r)<=(1+eta_n)Var(e)
notes: Property max Z^2<=2log p+o(log n) => NA(L). Verified separately per family (LOC-d, LOC-BF, Poly). PLR (C-i) hypothesis.

name: Instance: compound symmetry (exact Gram or iid CS rows)
statement: X'X=(n-1)Ups[(1-rho)I+rho 11']Ups, rho in (0,1) fixed, Ups diag +-1; iid-row version: A:IID-GAUSS-ROWS with CS covariance
notes: Family-named: property used is P:CS-1D-REDUCTION (exact in the exact-Gram case); iid case X1+X2 perturbation. Instance of A:INST-FACTOR with kappa=1.

name: Instance: one-factor Gram with exposure ratio kappa<=kbar
statement: Sigma=lambda lambda'+Psi, Psi block-diagonal groups size<=gbar, lambda_min(Psi)>=psi0, kappa(lambda,Psi,G)<=kbar
notes: Property used: uniform add bound P:ADD-BOUND. Block CS has kappa=1 (W2-FAC-A:Lemma-kappa).

name: Growth below alpha0(kbar)
statement: limsup log p/log n<alpha0(kbar)=1/(2kbar(kbar+2)); alpha0(1)=1/6
notes: Balancing exponent: add-stat budget 2(log p/log n)max_r[(1+kbar r)^2-r^2]<1 vs BB-ratio budget. Sharp for CS full-lattice route (W2-FAC-A:Prop-SHARP).

name: Growth below n^{1/2} (iid CS)
statement: limsup log p/log n<1/2
notes: Beyond 1/2 the uniform-over-n form of (C2)(ii) is false (R20 item 1).

name: p<=floor(n/2) (exact CS)
statement: p_n<=floor(n/2) eventually so K=p; p_n need not grow
notes: K=p means full lattice feasible. Frontier K<p<=16K/15 unresolved; liminf p/K>16/15 fails via W2-FAC-PK:Thm-NEG.

name: K+16s0+1<=p<=n-1 (exact CS beyond K)
statement: K+16s0+1<=p_n<=n-1 for large n (PK')
notes: Used by P1, Thm-NEG and Thm-PATH. NEG additionally needs liminf p/K>16/15 and (PB).

name: liminf p/K>16/15 and (PB)
statement: (PK): (PK') and liminf p_n/K_n>16/15; (PB): blocks<=16, all but J0 of size exactly 16
notes: Used in the counterexample sense by Thm-NEG only.

name: Gaussian-residual omitted part (MIS)
statement: omega=a1+X_C gamma+xi, xi~N(0,tau^2 I) cond. indep. of eps given X_C; candidate problem has Gaussian noise sigma_C^2=sigma^2+tau^2
notes: Used by MIS (i),(ii) only (both headline). LemR reduces the candidate-only problem to a well-specified Gaussian model with truth beta^C.

name: Polynomial decay alpha>17/2
statement: |Sigma_jk|<=K(1+|pi(j)-pi(k)|)^{-alpha}, spectrum in [c,C], alpha>alpha0=17/2
notes: alpha0=17/2 is a proof counting limit (selection removal/junk exclusion), not a necessity statement.

name: Instance: LH-iid masked designs
statement: iid N(0,Sigma) rows, groups of size g with equicorrelation rho, c linked pairs (hub) with 0<|psi_i|<rho, SIZE, 18<=p<=n^A
notes: Family-named instance (masking by rank-one hub links). Used by PXN, GEN (C5)(b), C-DLV classes. Property used: partition recovery + lattice reference S0 minus M.

name: N1 kernel/start premises
statement: START (draw_pi0 exact), KERNEL (coded step functions realise T12 kernels), MEAS, SI (final stream independent of streams 0-9), potential run, worker equivalence
notes: Design-free: no regime assumption on X. Inherits N9 'PROVED (candidate), code-checked'.

name: Posterior concentration at S0
statement: 1-pi(S0|y)=O_P(sqrt(log n/n)); hence exact HPM=MPM=S0 w.p.->1 and E[1-pi(S0)]->0
notes: Consumed by every reported-model claim via M5(0): P(O & S+!=S0)<=2E[1-pi(S0)]+D_n.

name: De-randomisation (every-sequence/common-envelope)
statement: if every deterministic sequence x_n in X-event A_n satisfies the fixed-design conclusion with common constants/envelopes, the joint-law conclusion holds (diagonal tightness)
notes: Conditional convergence alone is not enough. Used by GEN(C4), MIS(ii), FAC-A L5, APP POST/LOC, FAC-X.

name: Uniform score expansion over polynomial families
statement: EXP': uniform expansion of F(S) differences, RSS floor/ceiling, contrast bounds on families with log|F|<=O(log n) (or (log n)^k)
notes: Variants C-GROW:L0.1 (O(log n) sets), W2-LOC2:L0' (quasi-polynomial). Uses A:GAUSS-NOISE, A:ENERGY, A:P-POLY.

name: Start mode equals/sandwiches the reference
statement: pi0(S*)->1 so S~0=S* (GEN/PXN/CS) or S0<=S~0<=Q for every maximiser (GROW/FAC/LOC)
notes: Per-family lemmas: W1-GEN:L2, W1-PXN:Thm-PXN(E), C-GROW:L3, W2-FAC-A:L2, W2-FAC-B:L2, W2-FAC-X:X5.

name: Sandwich event Sand_n(Q)
statement: S0<=S~<=Q for every maximiser S~ of gamma0 on Omega, Q deterministic
notes: Consumed by GROW, FAC-L, LOC, PLR, F-UNI. Property form of A:BLOCK-VIS + A:RELEVANCE-SIZE.

name: NA/TL lattice events
statement: NA(L): all additions from T in L lose; TL(L): every feasible neighbour not containing S0 has smaller F; probability ->1
notes: TL needs A:BETAMIN (BM-inf); NA needs the uniform add bound (G4-chi/G4-dir/alpha0/NA-R). Per family: C-GROW:L2.3, W2-FAC-A:L3.1, W2-LOC2:NA-R, W2-APP:L3.6.

name: Deterministic LS0 scores S0
statement: D_n=P(O_bar & S0 not in S_bar+)->0 via lattice descent: path from centre C takes |C minus S0| deletions; capped search scores S0 if cap>=|C minus S0|-1
notes: Consumed by every reported-model claim; GEN bridge W1-GEN:L4/L5, CS path lemma W2-FAC-B:L4, PK path W2-FAC-PK:L3.4.

name: Composition bound M5(0)
statement: every n, any X: P(O & S+!=S0)<=2E[1-pi(S0)]+D_n; if S0 in S+ and pi(S0)>1/2 then S+=S0
notes: Needs A:OP (and CAL for the assembly); SOP:TH05.0 is itself a headline claim.

name: Blocks = groups w.h.p.
statement: P(A_n^c)<=p^{-C}, A_n={blocks=groups}, summable under SIZE on LH-iid
notes: Only PXN (and GEN (C5)(b), conditional).

name: Uniform conditional-covariance decay
statement: Cov(W_j,W_k|W_U) decays exponentially uniformly in U; conditional spectra in [c,C]; l1/pointwise bounds on regression coefficients
notes: Variants W2-LOC2:CD_d, W2-UNI:CD_M. Feeds P:SAND and NA via windowed innovations.

name: Uniform add-statistic bound (one factor)
statement: |Z_{T,l}|<=sqrt(2log(p2^gbar)+2loglog n)+kappa' sqrt(2loglog n)+kbar(sqrt(2log(e gbar p/|T|))+rho_n) uniformly in T,l w.p.>=1-3/log n
notes: Gives NA with the BB ratio under A:P-ALPHA0.

name: CS exact one-dimensional reduction
statement: under exact compound symmetry score and all deletion/addition/swap gains are exact functions of (k,sum z,sum z^2) with one common centre x_T
notes: Family-named CS restated as the property used. iid-row analogue: X1+X2 (perturbation of the reference statistic).

name: Total fallback: P(no output)=0
statement: with tier-1 fallback freezing the pilot schedule P(U_n)=0 for all n>=3; P(S+=S0)->1 via P(LS0 scores S0)->1 and delta1->0 (pathwise, no CAL)
notes: Consumed by F-FAC, F-LOC2, F-UNI, FAC-CS (C4), FAC-CS-iid (C4). C-DLV:O (P(SL_n)->0 without patch) is OPEN.

name: Coefficients bounded above and below
statement: theta*_j in [theta_lo, theta_hi] in absolute value on S0 (fixed constants)
notes: POST setting; implies a fixed beta-min

name: Polynomial relevance set Q
statement: Q of radius ceil(D n^{1/(2 alpha)}) around S0, |Q| = O(n^{1/(2 alpha)}) (polynomial, not log/polylog)
notes: distinct from A:RELEVANCE-SIZE (bounded/log/polylog)

name: COEF-REP
statement: exists T in Omega, theta: X_T theta=mu, ||theta||^2<=nM' (L1a' only; implied by A:SPARSE-EIG at S0 and A:ENERGY with M'=1.5M/phi0^2)
notes: added by ingest from b7_wave3.jsonl

name: EXT-FEAS
statement: 1<=s0
notes: added by ingest from b7_wave3.jsonl

name: EX-A-HU
statement: exact arithmetic (EX-A) and iid U[0,1) stream (H-U)
notes: added by ingest from b7_wave3.jsonl

name: P-MAP
statement: P(S†≠S0)→0, S† the hpm_better-maximum of Omega (implied by P:POST-CONC)
notes: added by ingest from b7_wave3.jsonl

name: P-OVL
statement: 1_A·D_r·π0(S0)→∞ in probability
notes: added by ingest from b7_wave3.jsonl

name: IND-T
statement: streams 10-13 mutually independent and independent of streams 0-9 (D-ii only)
notes: added by ingest from b7_wave3.jsonl

name: NC-R
statement: lim_{eta->0} limsup_n P(A ∩ {W_r<eta})=0 (computational non-collapse; LT-e′: sigma(data,C)-measurable eta_n with 1_A·o1/eta_n→0)
notes: added by ingest from b7_wave3.jsonl

name: P-START
statement: 1_A·o0→0, i.e. π0(S0)→1 on A, no rate (input, PROGRAM item 2)
notes: added by ingest from b7_wave3.jsonl

name: P-OVL-INF
statement: P(A ∩ {L/M<=c})→0 for every c>0, M=max_S π(S)/π0(S) (global overlap relative to executed L)
notes: added by ingest from b7_wave3.jsonl
